name: comments
description: Comment system router. When enabled on a page, delegates to the configured comment system (Disqus or Utterances). Extensible: override comments.html to change routing.

params.description: Enable comments section on this page
params.effect: Renders the configured comment system (requires site-level comment config too)

config.routing_note: comments.html routes to disqus.html if params.disqus is set. Override comments.html to add more routing logic.

assets.size_impact: ~0KB — this is a router partial, actual assets from disqus/utterances

locked.reason: Pure routing logic, no locked elements

partials.note: Override to change routing: use utterances instead of disqus, or support both
